audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's focus ability is a fabricated name, "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" — Hwei has no ability by that name. Packet defects flag this: the page never names any of his real abilities.
audit.why: Hwei's real kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. His CC lives on E (Subject: Torment), which offers Grim Visage (root), Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. The invented name is repeated across tldr/winCon/enemyWin/loading/focus/cooldowns/feeding/dos/report.
audit.corrected: Replaced every occurrence of "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" with the real "Subject: Torment (E)".

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side and phases[1].side read "Hwei" while content win[0]/win[1] and whys[0]/whys[1] both say Janna wins levels 1-2 (Hwei is immobile, single combo, no follow-up).
audit.why: The mirror check: full and content must name the same side per row. Content's whys array is well-grounded (Hwei has no mobility pre-6 and the E-shield eats his one poke), so content is right and the full-layer side/why for rows 0-1 are stale.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0].side and phases[1].side to Janna (matching win[0]/win[1], no win edit needed) and rewrote their why text to state the Janna-favored reasoning instead of generic filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why (Level 6, First item) describe Janna favorably ("Monsoon online", "shields grow") while content win[4]/win[5] and whys[4]/whys[5] say Hwei owns both stages via EE execute burst and Malignance/Liandry's zone control.
audit.why: Content is grounded in real item/ability references (Malignance, Liandry's, his combo burst) and packet.levelChart agrees Hwei wins levels 3-6. The full-layer why text for these rows was left over from a different (Janna-favored) verdict.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[2..5].side off the flat "Skill" placeholder to match win[2..5]=Hwei, and rewrote phases[3].why/phases[4].why/phases[5].why to state the Hwei-favored reasoning.
